headline: HDFCBANK delivered on most of its guidance for Whole Bank and Retail segments, with some mixed results on advance growth expectations.

segments.Whole Bank: Advance growth (YoY) fell short of strong ambitions but is expected to improve in the next quarter. Cost-to-Income Ratio and CASA Ratio were under control as productivity improvements brought in efficiencies.
segments.Retail: Retail share of advances grew, contributing to overall growth momentum.
